question: The Central Government launched the National Air Sports Policy in the year __________ .
solution:
The correct naswer is __**2022**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The National Air Sports Policy was launched by the Central Government in the year **2022**.
 
• This policy aims to promote air sports by making it safe, affordable, accessible, enjoyable, and sustainable.
 
• It covers various air sports such as aerobatics, aeromodelling, ballooning, drones, gliding, hang gliding
